nvEncodeAPI.h: NVIDIA Video Codec SDK encoder interface, version 13.1, as distributed in FFmpeg's nv-codec-headers
(https://github.com/FFmpeg/nv-codec-headers, include/ffnvcodec/nvEncodeAPI.h, fetched 2026-11-20). Kept exactly as it came.
Its own notice at the top of the file (an MIT-style permission, copyright NVIDIA Corporation) is its licence.
The encoder itself is part of the graphics driver (nvEncodeAPI64.dll); nothing of NVIDIA's is shipped with the engine.
